description: This file manages storage and retrieval of access and refresh tokens in local storage for client-side authentication, providing functions to get, set, clear, and check tokens, with backward compatibility support.

methods.name: normalizeStoredToken
methods.description: Normalizes stored token strings by trimming and checking for null, undefined, or empty values.

methods.name: stripBearerPrefix
methods.description: Removes the 'Bearer ' prefix from token strings, handling various edge cases.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored access token, with fallback to legacy key and normalization.

methods.name: setTokens
methods.description: Stores access and refresh tokens after stripping the 'Bearer' prefix, maintaining backward compatibility.

methods.name: clearTokens
methods.description: Removes stored token entries from local storage to log out or handle 401 errors.

methods.name: hasAnyToken
methods.description: Checks if any valid access or refresh token is stored.
